# mondoo_integration_attack_surface (Resource)

Continuously discover and scan the external attack surface of one or more domains: the domains themselves, their subdomains, and what they expose. TLS, HTTP, DNS, email security and known-vulnerability checks always run; the attributes below turn the other scans on or off.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "mondoo" {
  space = "hungry-poet-123456"
}

# Scan a domain and its subdomains every day, with the default scans
resource "mondoo_integration_attack_surface" "example" {
  domains = ["example.com"]
}

# Scan two domains weekly, with subdomain takeover and cloud discovery turned on
resource "mondoo_integration_attack_surface" "weekly" {
  name               = "Example domains, weekly"
  domains            = ["example.org", "example.net"]
  schedule           = "168h"
  subdomain_takeover = true
  cloud_discovery    = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domains` (List of String) Domains to scan, for example `example.com`. Lowercase, 1 to 100 of them.

### Optional

- `cloud_discovery` (Boolean) Discover cloud assets (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) tied to the domains. Defaults to `false`.
- `name` (String) Name of the integration. Defaults to the first domain.
- `pause_scanning` (Boolean) Pause scheduled scans. Defaults to `false`.
- `port_scan` (Boolean) Scan for open ports and exposed services. Defaults to `true`.
- `schedule` (String) How often to scan: a Go duration of at least `24h` (for example `24h`, `168h` or `336h`), a cron expression, or `once`. With `once`, the provider starts that scan when it creates the integration, unless `pause_scanning` is `true`. Defaults to `24h`.
- `space_id` (String) Mondoo space identifier. If there is no space ID, the provider space is used.
- `subdomain_takeover` (Boolean) Detect dangling DNS records vulnerable to subdomain takeover. Defaults to `false`.
- `subdomains` (Boolean) Discover and scan subdomains of the domains. Defaults to `true`.
- `vulnerability_scanning` (Boolean) Run active vulnerability checks against discovered assets. Defaults to `true`.
- `web_fingerprint` (Boolean) Fingerprint web technologies. Defaults to `true`.
- `webscan` (Boolean) Run a dynamic web application scan. Slow, and can be intrusive. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `mrn` (String) Integration identifier.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import using integration MRN.
terraform import mondoo_integration_attack_surface.example "//captain.api.mondoo.app/spaces/hungry-poet-123456/integrations/2Abd08lk860"
```
